Table 2: Performance comparison with KG-RAG and KGR methods. MRAG, LRAG, and KRAG are KG-RAG baselines. TransE, RotatE, CAGED, and LLM_Sim are KGR methods applied to refine the KG, whose effects are evaluated using KRAG due to its operation at the triplet-level retrieval granularity. Best results are highlighted in bold, and worst results in red. ↑ indicates the accuracy improvement over the worst result.
